Hi, I’m Aditi! I’m pursuing a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University in Melbourne, with a background in Information Science and experience in Programmatic Advertising at MiQ Digital.

Working with campaign performance data sparked my interest in how analysis can inform business decisions. I’m particularly interested in marketing analytics, data visualisation and communicating findings clearly.

This blog is a space where I explore data and share the stories behind it. Outside my studies, I enjoy travelling and exploring new places!
